The '''beam splitter''' was a [[firing chamber]] customization for many [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weapons that significantly broadened the energy beam, on a greater scale than the [[Amplifying chamber/Legends|amplifying chamber]], resulting in increased damage. The Mark I, II, and III versions in turn allowed for considerable boosts in the potential for injury from the [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] energy. A jury-rigged version of the beam splitter employed three [[beam gem]]s salvaged from [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computers]] and installed in the barrel of the blaster.
